👋 余，t8y2

总角之年，初触代码，不过稚子嬉戏耳。不意廿载倏忽，竟以此为业。其间由前端而后端，由桌面而数据，所学愈广，所未知者亦愈多。然探索之心，未尝稍减。

能亲操键，亦善假 AI 之力。或 Rust，或 Go，或 TypeScript，前后端皆涉，桌面应用亦多。 数据库自 MySQL 至 DuckDB 靡不摆弄，框架自 Vue 至 Tauri 皆有交付。不拘工具，唯问产出。

性 INTJ，讷言敏行。不尚空谈，不好著文，但以代码见真章。每有所思，辄夜半起而操键，不知东方之既白。

躬耕开源，DBX、Motty、Viva、UniHub、PolarisDesk 皆心血之作。 每成一器，必倾力而为。从无到有，其间自有乐趣；倘有用户称善，则足矣。

造物而已，尽心而已。

Models

Zen generates. Enso routes. Kai decides. Nio enforces.

Model Focus & Architecture

Enso Adaptive model family & router — routes every call, in every modality, to the optimal model
Kai Decision model — block speculative diffusion turning heterogeneous evidence into calibrated, typed decisions
Nio Deterministic policy authority — joins on allow < ask < deny, governs action execution under invariant policy

Uta Original song composition, cue-driven scoring, and multi-track music production (/v1/music)
Jin Real-time bidirectional streaming, voice activity detection (VAD), and conversational agent interaction

Hanzo builds and runs these for companies: hanzo.ai/enterprise · hanzo.ai/contact
